name: LinguaLens ambiguity review pilot v1
provenance: LinguaLens-authored pilot benchmark v1.0.0. Candidate annotations pending independent review.

stimulus.sentence: The guard watched the rider with binoculars.

reference.annotation: PP attachment allows a seeing instrument reading (VP) and a rider possession reading (NP). Inspect two distinct trees and keep the same lexical yield.

stimulus.sentence: We photographed the statue near the fountain.

reference.annotation: The PP can locate the photographing event or modify the statue. More fine-grained attachment analyses should be adjudicated.
There is no competing constituent attachment in the intended simple intransitive analysis.
In the intended reading the adjective is inside the subject NP. Lexical senses are outside this structural-attachment item.
